_comment: Universe for the discovery-driven dry-run probe (tools/probe-dry-run.mjs --continuous). Pools come from tools/seed-registry-defillama.mjs (DefiLlama pairs + factory view-calls); seedTokens below only bootstrap USD pricing. TVL band widened to $5M per operator request (2026-08-14) — Arbitrum dense below $500K, OP/Base liquidity sits higher.
_filter_comment: Liquidity filter: $10K floor avoids dust/scam pools; $5M ceiling (widened from $500K on 2026-08-14 — OP/Base liquidity concentrates higher than Arbitrum).
_discovery_comment: Event-based discovery is DEAD on BlockPi (factory events not indexed). Registry is populated by tools/seed-registry-defillama.mjs instead. Incremental event sync still runs but finds ~0; keep refresh cadence modest. Re-run the seeder periodically to pick up new DefiLlama pools.
